notes: Building and Engineering News, vol. 27 part 1 (Internet Archive buildingengineer227cont), the weekly issues from 8 January to 25 June 1927. Same method as vol. 26: every numbered entry under Building Permit Applications and Building Contracts was taken from the djvu.xml OCR, East Bay headings set aside, and each San Francisco lot built from the block corner on the DPW street centrelines and compared with the sf-parcels shapes; a placement was accepted where the lot starts within two feet of a lot line of today (or the record names an unambiguous corner) and the roll dates the building 1926-1929, and alterations were matched by printed street number in sf-eas-addresses where the roll dates the building before 1927. Every published row was read against the page image, location first; about 240 of the 358 rows read needed a name, a cost or the wording corrected, and a cost that could not be read on the image was left out. Where a permit and its contract appear in the same issue the page carries one entry and the contract finding is held. Descriptions of rows marked confidence low were built from the OCR and have not been read against the image. Owners are private individuals and are cut everywhere (raw.note); a firm or institution named as owner is kept. Completion notices, liens, sub-contracts printed 'on above' and the news columns were not taken. Issue dates come from the running heads (redate.py), checked to be weekly and unbroken.

coverage.remaining: Vol. 26 parts 1 and 2 and vol. 27 part 1 read; the other 31 half-year volumes (1915 to January 1932) are unread, vol. 27 part 2 (buildingengineer2127cont, July-December 1927) next. In this volume: 449 rows placed on a parcel whose roll year fits, all single houses with no architect named and no page, are logged and held until another fact gives the parcel a page (extra.placed_apn; they still need the image check). 536 rows have a nearest parcel that was not accepted (the lot starts off today's lot lines, or the roll dates the building outside the window). 822 rows were not placed: 405 location lines not parsed (tract lots, garbled headings), 264 street pairs that do not cross under the names read (OCR spellings, renamed streets) and 153 printed street numbers with no EAS row today. One accepted parcel (1702010P) has no EAS address row and is held.
coverage.note: 3,479 numbered entries read, 2,165 San Francisco rows, 1,343 placed on a parcel, 358 picked and read against the page image, 345 published on 336 pages (240 seeded), 12 held back at the image check (same-issue contracts merged into the permit entry, repeat listings, uses that contradict the roll).
